    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
      seen=$((seen+1))

      id=$(echo "$line" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"id\"])")

      if echo "$lower" | grep -qE "interview|tips|final"; then
        echo "MATCH: $typ $id \"$name\" in $path" >&2
      fi
